Under exactly Marx's existential rank similarity and a fixed finite ordered outcome alphabet, the sharp simultaneous policy-mean set is a finite nonconvex union of common-rank path images, each attained by one law. This finite-alphabet missing-support class and Marx's full-support class are nonnested; the reduction to Marx applies only on their finite-alphabet full-support overlap, and the observable monotonicity inequalities are derived from the latent model. Path survival gives the exact Hausdorff continuity frontier and a centered local Lipschitz bound. A legal three-outcome contiguous submodel proves that globally honest metric procedures cannot shrink uniformly. A terminating finite algorithm computes the multinomial outer set, the set-of-sets image, and their exact Hausdorff radii; finite-sample coverage is the direct inversion corollary. On every certified continuity law, the full projected Hausdorff-loss germ is recovered pointwise on the exact multinomial sampling face, including continuous multi-path switches, propensity--grid ties, and exact lower-dimensional structural-zero faces; this requires positive instrument shares and does not imply globally shrinking honest metric inference.
